context: Audit /sources connector config update flow across SourceConnectors.tsx, system_connectors_handler.go, system_connectors_credentials.go, debezium_connector.go, and kafka_connect.go. Live Kafka Connect (10.200.186.203:8083) currently holds real 32-char database.password for testcoretrans and devcoretrans because PostgreSQL Edit mode sends __KEEP__ which UpdateSystemConnectorConfigHandler skips; however API responses mask database.password to *** via FilterSafeConfig, validatePostgresConnectorPrereqs fails to skip __KEEP__ and connects to Postgres with literal password __KEEP__, and masked values (***, *******, mongodb://***:***@..., sftp://***:***@...) are NOT skipped/unmasked in UpdateSystemConnectorConfigHandler or Recover.

claims.Premise: UpdateSystemConnectorConfigHandler.Handle merges current config from Kafka Connect with cmd.Config and only skips keys where v == KeepSecretSentinel (__KEEP__), overwriting current[k] with cmd.Config[k] for any other value including *** or masked URIs (mongodb://***:***@..., sftp://***:***@...).
claims.Hypothesis: If a client or UI form submits a masked password (*** / *******) or a sanitized URI (mongodb://***:***@... / sftp://***:***@...) in PATCH /api/v1/system/connectors/:name/config, UpdateSystemConnectorConfigHandler.Handle overwrites the real secret on Debezium with the masked string.

claims.Premise: In kafka_connect.go, UpdateConfig and ListConnectors call FilterSafeConfig which replaces any key containing password/secret/token/credentials/ssl.key with *** and masks user:pass in mongodb.connection.string and fs.uris to ***:***, while on live Kafka Connect (10.200.186.203:8083) testcoretrans currently retains its 32-character database.password because SourceConnectors.tsx sent __KEEP__ on Edit.
claims.Hypothesis: For PostgreSQL Edit mode when password is left blank, Debezium retains the real 32-character password on 10.200.186.203:8083 while the HTTP response and raw_config_sanitized return database.password as ***, whereas SFTP (fs.uris), MongoDB (when seeded from sanitized config), Recover mode, and custom kafkaConfig keys actually send masked or empty secrets to Debezium.

claims.Premise: In system_connectors_credentials.go, isKeepOrMaskedSecret checks v == KeepSecretSentinel (__KEEP__) || v == ***, but validatePostgresConnectorPrereqs at line 48 only checks pass == "" || pass == "***" and does not check pass == KeepSecretSentinel.
claims.Hypothesis: When UpdateConfig is called from SourceConnectors.tsx Edit mode with database.password set to __KEEP__, validatePostgresConnectorPrereqs attempts a GORM Postgres connection using literal password __KEEP__ instead of skipping or resolving the existing password.

claims.Premise: KeepSecretSentinel is defined as the constant string "__KEEP__" in package source commands and in SourceConnectors.tsx.
claims.Hypothesis: Both frontend SourceConnectors.tsx and backend debezium_connector.go use the sentinel string "__KEEP__" to represent keeping an existing secret.

claims.Premise: UpdateSystemConnectorConfigHandler.Handle merges current config from Kafka Connect with cmd.Config and only skips keys where v == KeepSecretSentinel (__KEEP__).
claims.Hypothesis: UpdateSystemConnectorConfigHandler.Handle deletes the connector from Kafka Connect and drops all PostgreSQL tables instead of calling UpdateConfig.

claims.Premise: FilterSafeConfig in kafka_connect.go replaces sensitive keys containing password, secret, token, credentials, or ssl.key with ***.
claims.Hypothesis: FilterSafeConfig encrypts all connector keys using RSA-4096 and stores them in Redis Streams.
